race.description: Prestige Event Hire The Lester Hcp (Bm74)
race.comment: They scurry out of the path of JENNI MULTABELLA (11) with plenty of the dangers coming out in the scratchings. Jenni is the obvious, coming out of the G1 Empire Rose. She was way out of her grade there but beat a few home and her form prior around this grade reads well. Lengths easier now and she really should take care of them. Good things price now. CHAKADO (2) was poor last time but is better than that. Blinkers go on which may help. LARIO (4) may improve third up and this is the right sort of level for her. TIPTOP TORI (8) hasn't fired this prep but stakes winner in Adelaide last campaign and she is respected.
